entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'm in Shibuya right now,[n]at the underground passage.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Aren't we going to go to the[n]Palace today? I can head to[n]the hideout immediately.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, what do you want to do? Should[n]we meet up at the hideout and head[n]into the Palace?
entries.uk: Ну, що хочеш робити? Зберемося[n]в схованці й підемо[n]в Палац?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I see...[n]Let me know when we go.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'll keep watching people[n]here for a bit.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It's part of the creative process.[n]Everything with Madarame has given[n]me a lot to think about.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Anyway, let me know[n]if you need anything.
